# IDecayController
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/interfaces/IDecayController.sol)

**Title:**
IDecayController

Interface for the DecayController contract that manages decay updates


## Errors
### DecayController__ZeroAddress
Error thrown when a zero address is provided for the summer token


```solidity
error DecayController__ZeroAddress();
```

### DecayController__RewardsManagerAlreadySet
Error thrown when the rewards manager is already set


```solidity
error DecayController__RewardsManagerAlreadySet();
```
